  |k17cv05 Deployable Archive with Excel Integration
  |
  |Before you can use the functions packaged by the compiler, you need to do the following:
  |
  |* Deploy k17cv05.ctf to a server instance.
  |* Install the Excel add-in on the client machine.
  |* Configure the add-in with information about the server instance.
  |
  |1. Deploy k17cv05.ctf
  |
  |1.1 Prerequisites to k17cv05.ctf Deployment
  |Before you can deploy k17cv05.ctf, you need a server instance to host it. The server 
  |instance must be configured to have access to MATLAB Runtime(R2025b).
  |
  |1.2 k17cv05.ctf Deployment
  |To deploy k17cv05.ctf, copy it from `for_redistribution_files_only\server` or 
  |`k17cv05productionServerArchive` to the server instance's `auto_deploy` folder. The 
  |server instance will automatically deploy it.
  |
  |For more information on deploying k17cv05.ctf to MATLAB Production Server, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/mts/server-management.html
  |
  |2. Install Excel Add-In
  |
  |2.1 Using the Installer
  |The Production Server Compiler app generates an installer in the 
  |`for_redistribution\client` folder that will install the Excel Add-In and register all of 
  |the required DLLs.
  |
  |To configure the add-in, enter the information to contact the server instance hosting 
  |k17cv05.ctf in the add-in installer when prompted.
  |
  |2.2 Manual Installation
  |In the output folder, you will find the following files:
  |
  |* `k17cv05.dll` - dynamic library required by the add-in 
  |* `k17cv05.bas` - VBA module file created for the add-in
  |* `k17cv05.xla` - Excel add-in file
  |* `serverconfig.dll` - dynamic library managing the server configuration used by the add-in
  |
  |On the client machine running the add-in, you must register the following DLLs with the 
  |`regAsm` command:
  |
  |* `regAsm k17cv05.dll`
  |* `regAsm serverconfig.dll`
  |
  |If `k17cv05.xla` is generated, install the add-in into Excel. If not, import 
  |`k17cv05.bas` to the workbook's Visual Basic project. 
  |
  |Once the add-in is installed, set the server configuration information using the 
  |ServerConfig Excel add-in.
  |
  |For more information on registering and installing the add-in, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/compiler/excel/distribute-add-ins-and-integrate-into-microsoft-excel.html

  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "MPS server URL is {0}.", url);
  |
  |                if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MPS server url is not provided for k17blank");
  |                    output0 = "MATLAB error thrown : MPS server url is not provided for k17blank";
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    // Initialize the connection with server
  |                    if ((serverUrl != url) || (timeout != timeoutMilliSeconds) || (responseLimit != responseSizeLimit) || (interfaceObject == null))
  |                    {
  |                        if (mwClient != null)
  |                        {
  |                            mwClient.Dispose();
  |                            TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient is disposed.");
  |                        }
  |                        serverUrl = url;
  |                        timeoutMilliSeconds = timeout;
  |                        responseSizeLimit = responseLimit;
  |                        mwClient = new MWHttpClient(new k17blankClientConfig());
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "New MWHttpClient is created.");
  |                        interfaceObject = mwClient.CreateProxy<IK17Blank>(new Uri(url));
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient.CreateProxy() succeeded.");
  |                    }
  |
  |                    interfaceObject.k17_one(out output0,input_list.ToArray());
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function returned.");
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Output y is {0}.", output0.ToString());
  |                }
  |            }//end of try
  |            catch (MATLABException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch MATLAB Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MATLAB Exception stack trace is {0}", ex.MATLABStackTraceString);
  |                String errorMsg = "MATLABException:" + ex.MATLABIdentifier;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (WebException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch WebException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "WebException status is {0}", ex.Status);
  |        
  |                HttpWebResponse response = (HttpWebResponse)ex.Response;
  |                if (response != null)
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status code: {0}", response.StatusCode);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status description: {0}", response.StatusDescription);
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + response.StatusDescription;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "No response received in WebException.");
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + ex.Status;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch TargetInvocationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "InnerException is {0}", ex.InnerException);
  |                String errorMsg = "TargetInvocationException:" + ex.InnerException;
  |
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function failed.");
  |                //When the log file reached its max size
  |                if (ex.Message.Contains("MaxFileSize"))
  |                {
  |                    string filename = "";
  |                    if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                    {
  |                        FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                        filename = fListener.FullLogFileName;
  |                    }
  |                    String errorMsg = ex.Message + " Delete or rename the log file " + filename + " and run the function again.";
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch InvalidOperationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                    String errorMsg = "InvalidOperationException:" + ex.Message;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (Exception ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_one function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                String errorMsg = "Exception:" + ex.Message;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            y = output0;
  |
  |            if (loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                traceSource.Flush();
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            return;
  |        }

  |                /// <summary>
  |        /// Provides an interface for the k17_many function in which the input and output
  |        /// arguments are specified as Objects.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        /// <param name="nargout">The number of output arguments to return</param>
  |        /// <param name="s">Output argument #1</param>
  |        /// <param name="d">Output argument #2</param>
  |        /// <param name="p">Output argument #3</param>
  |        /// <param name="a">Input argument #1</param>
  |        /// <param name="b">Input argument #2</param>
  |        /// <param name="c">Input argument #3</param>
  |        ///
  |        public void k17_many(int nargout, out Object s, out Object d, out Object p, 
  |               params Object[] inputs)
  |        {
  |            object output0 = null;
  |            object output1 = null;
  |            object output2 = null;
  |            Range range = null;
  |            try
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Entered k17_many() function.");      
  |                ArrayList input_list = new ArrayList();
  |
  |                int idx = 1;
  |                foreach (Object input in inputs)
  |                {                    
  |                    if (input == Type.Missing)
  |                        break;
  |
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Input {0} is {1}.", idx, input);
  |
  |                    if (input is Range)
  |                    {
  |                        range = input as Range;
  |                        input_list.Add(range.Value);
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Input {0} is Range with value of {1}.", idx, range.Value);
  |                    }
  |                    else
  |                    {
  |                        input_list.Add(input);
  |                    }
  |                    idx++;
  |                }
  |
  |                string url = getServerConfig("k17blank");
  |                int timeout = getTimeoutMilliSeconds("k17blank");
  |                int responseLimit = getResponseSizeLimit("k17blank");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "MPS server URL is {0}.", url);
  |
  |                if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MPS server url is not provided for k17blank");
  |                    output0 = "MATLAB error thrown : MPS server url is not provided for k17blank";
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    // Initialize the connection with server
  |                    if ((serverUrl != url) || (timeout != timeoutMilliSeconds) || (responseLimit != responseSizeLimit) || (interfaceObject == null))
  |                    {
  |                        if (mwClient != null)
  |                        {
  |                            mwClient.Dispose();
  |                            TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient is disposed.");
  |                        }
  |                        serverUrl = url;
  |                        timeoutMilliSeconds = timeout;
  |                        responseSizeLimit = responseLimit;
  |                        mwClient = new MWHttpClient(new k17blankClientConfig());
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "New MWHttpClient is created.");
  |                        interfaceObject = mwClient.CreateProxy<IK17Blank>(new Uri(url));
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient.CreateProxy() succeeded.");
  |                    }
  |
  |                    interfaceObject.k17_many(out output0,out output1,out output2,input_list.ToArray());
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function returned.");
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Output s is {0}.", output0.ToString());
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Output d is {0}.", output1.ToString());
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Output p is {0}.", output2.ToString());
  |                }
  |            }//end of try
  |            catch (MATLABException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch MATLAB Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MATLAB Exception stack trace is {0}", ex.MATLABStackTraceString);
  |                String errorMsg = "MATLABException:" + ex.MATLABIdentifier;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (WebException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch WebException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "WebException status is {0}", ex.Status);
  |        
  |                HttpWebResponse response = (HttpWebResponse)ex.Response;
  |                if (response != null)
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status code: {0}", response.StatusCode);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status description: {0}", response.StatusDescription);
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + response.StatusDescription;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "No response received in WebException.");
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + ex.Status;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch TargetInvocationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "InnerException is {0}", ex.InnerException);
  |                String errorMsg = "TargetInvocationException:" + ex.InnerException;
  |
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function failed.");
  |                //When the log file reached its max size
  |                if (ex.Message.Contains("MaxFileSize"))
  |                {
  |                    string filename = "";
  |                    if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                    {
  |                        FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                        filename = fListener.FullLogFileName;
  |                    }
  |                    String errorMsg = ex.Message + " Delete or rename the log file " + filename + " and run the function again.";
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch InvalidOperationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                    String errorMsg = "InvalidOperationException:" + ex.Message;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (Exception ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_many function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                String errorMsg = "Exception:" + ex.Message;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            s = output0;
  |            d = output1;
  |            p = output2;
  |
  |            if (loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                traceSource.Flush();
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            return;
  |        }

  |        private static string getLogFileLocation()
  |        {
  |            string url = null;
  |            RegistryKey key = getLoggingRegistryKey();
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                object value = key.GetValue("LogFileFolder");
  |                if (value is string)
  |                {
  |                    url = (string)value;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            return url;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static RegistryKey getLoggingRegistryKey()
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                RegistryKey localMachineRegistry= RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine,
  |                                          Environment.Is64BitOperatingSystem ? RegistryView.Registry64 : RegistryView.Registry32);
  |                key = localMachineRegistry.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            }
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            }
  |            return key;
  |        }
  |                
  |        private static RegistryKey getAddinRegistryKey(string addinName)
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                RegistryKey localMachineRegistry= RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine,
  |                                          Environment.Is64BitOperatingSystem ? RegistryView.Registry64 : RegistryView.Registry32);
  |                key = localMachineRegistry.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            }
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            }
  |            return key;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static string getServerConfig(string name)
  |        {
  |            string url = null;
  |            RegistryKey key = getAddinRegistryKey(name);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry key " + key.Name + " found");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for mps server url for " + name);
  |                foreach (string valueName in key.GetValueNames())
  |                {
  |                    if(valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) || valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT))
  |                        continue;
  |
  |                    Object value = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + value) ;
  |
  |                    if (value is int)
  |                    {
  |                        if ((int)value == 1)
  |                        {
  |                            url = valueName;
  |                            if (url.EndsWith(".ctf"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Remove(url.IndexOf(".ctf"));
  |                            }
  |                            if (!url.StartsWith("http://") && !url.StartsWith("https://"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Insert(0, "http://");
  |                            }
  |                            return url;
  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Registry key " + name + " doesn't exist");
  |            }
  |
  |            return url;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static void DoLogging()
  |        {
  |            bool loggingEnabled = false;
  |            int loggingLevel = 0;
  |            string logFileFolder = "";
  |
  |            RegistryKey key = getLoggingRegistryKey();
  |            if (key == null)
  |                return;
  |
  |            Object value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOGGING_ENABLED);
  |            if (value != null && value is int)
  |            {
  |                loggingEnabled = ((int)value != 0);
  |            }
  |
  |            K17Blank.loggingEnabled = loggingEnabled;
  |            if (!loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                return;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOGGING_LEVEL);
  |            if (value != null && value is int)
  |            {
  |                loggingLevel = (int)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOG_FILE_FOLDER);
  |            if (value != null && value is string)
  |            {
  |                logFileFolder = (string)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            if (K17Blank.loggingLevel == loggingLevel && K17Blank.logFileFolder == logFileFolder)
  |                return;
  |
  |
  |            if (traceSource.Listeners.Count == 0)
  |            {
  |                K17Blank.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                K17Blank.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                InitializeTraceSourceListener();
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                {
  |                    FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                    if (logFileFolder != K17Blank.logFileFolder)
  |                    {
  |                        K17Blank.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                        fListener.CustomLocation = logFileFolder;
  |                    }
  |                    if (loggingLevel != K17Blank.loggingLevel)
  |                    {
  |                        K17Blank.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                        SetFileLogListenerFilter(fListener, loggingLevel);
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        private static void InitializeTraceSourceListener()
  |        {
  |            traceSource.Listeners.Clear();
  |
  |            // Initilize FileLogTraceListener      
  |            FileLogTraceListener fListener = new FileLogTraceListener();
  |            fListener.AutoFlush = true;
  |            fListener.Delimiter = "  ";
  |            String logFileFolder = getLogFileLocation();
  |            if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(logFileFolder))
  |            {
  |                fListener.Location = LogFileLocation.LocalUserApplicationDirectory;
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                fListener.Location = LogFileLocation.Custom;
  |                fListener.CustomLocation = logFileFolder;
  |            }
  |            fListener.TraceOutputOptions = TraceOptions.DateTime |
  |                                           TraceOptions.ProcessId;
  |            fListener.LogFileCreationSchedule = LogFileCreationScheduleOption.Daily;
  |
  |            fListener.BaseFileName = "k17blank";
  |
  |            fListener.DiskSpaceExhaustedBehavior = DiskSpaceExhaustedOption.ThrowException;
  |
  |            //fListener.MaxFileSize = 1500;
  |
  |            SetFileLogListenerFilter(fListener, K17Blank.loggingLevel);
  |
  |            traceSource.Listeners.Add(fListener);
  |
  |            Trace.AutoFlush = true;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static void SetFileLogListenerFilter(TraceListener listener, int loggingLevel)
  |        {
  |            if (loggingLevel == 0)
  |            {
  |                listener.Filter = new EventTypeFilter(SourceLevels.Error);
  |
  |            }
  |            else if (loggingLevel == 1)
  |            {
  |                listener.Filter = new EventTypeFilter(SourceLevels.Information);
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                listener.Filter = new EventTypeFilter(SourceLevels.All);
  |            }
  |        }

  |        private void TraceEvent(TraceEventType eventType, int id, string format, params Object[] args)
  |        {
  |            if (loggingEnabled && traceSource != null)
  |            {
  |                traceSource.TraceEvent(eventType, id, format, args);
  |            }
  |        }

  |        private static void TraceEvent(TraceEventType eventType, int id, string message)
  |        {
  |            if (loggingEnabled && traceSource != null)
  |            {
  |                traceSource.TraceEvent(eventType, id, message);
  |            }
  |        }

  |        static private void OnRegChanged(object sender, EventArgs e)
  |        {
  |            DoLogging();        
  |        }
  |
  |        private static bool getRegistryIntValue(string keyName, string valueName, ref int value)
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = getAddinRegistryKey(keyName);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry key " + key.Name + " found");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for " + valueName + " for " + keyName);
  |                foreach (string name in key.GetValueNames())
  |                {
  |                    if (name.Equals(valueName))
  |                    {
  |                        Object valueObj = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + valueObj.ToString());
  |
  |                        if(valueObj is int)
  |                        {
  |                            value = (int) valueObj;
  |                            return true;
  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Registry key " + keyName + " doesn't exist");
  |            }
  |            return false;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static int getTimeoutMilliSeconds(string keyName)
  |        {
  |            int timeout = 0;
  |            if (getRegistryIntValue(keyName, REGISTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, ref timeout) && (timeout > 0))
  |            {
  |                return timeout * 1000;
  |            }
  |            else 
  |            {
  |                return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000;
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        private static int getResponseSizeLimit(string keyName)
  |        {
  |            int limit = 0;
  |            if (getRegistryIntValue(keyName, REGISTRY_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT, ref limit) && (limit > 0))
  |            {
  |                return limit * 1024 * 1024;
  |            }
  |            else 
  |            {
  |                return DEFAULT_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT * 1024 * 1024;
  |            }
  |        }

  |            {
  |                get
  |                {
  |                    return getResponseSizeLimit("k17blank");
  |                    //return responseSizeLimit;
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }

  |            EventHandler handler = RegChanged;
  |            if (handler != null)
  |                handler(this, null);
  |        }

  |                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Monitoring thread is already running");

  |        private void InitRegistryKey(RegistryHive hive, string name)
  |        {
  |            switch (hive)
  |            {
  |                case RegistryHive.ClassesRoot:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.CurrentConfig:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.CurrentUser:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.DynData:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_DYN_DATA;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.LocalMachine:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.PerformanceData:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_PERFORMANCE_DATA;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.Users:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_USERS;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                default:
  |                    throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("hive", (int)hive, typeof (RegistryHive));
  |            }
  |            _registrySubName = name;
  |        }
  |
  |        private void InitRegistryKey(string name)
  |        {
  |            string[] nameParts = name.Split('\\');
  |
  |            switch (nameParts[0])
  |            {
  |                case "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT":
  |                case "HKCR":
  |                   _registryHive = HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_CURRENT_USER":
  |                case "HKCU":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE":
  |                    case "HKLM":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_USERS":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_USERS;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                default:
  |                    _registryHive = IntPtr.Zero;
  |                    throw new ArgumentException("The registry hive '" + nameParts[0] + "' is not supported", "value");
  |            }
  |
  |            _registrySubName = String.Join("\\", nameParts, 1, nameParts.Length - 1);
  |        }
  |        
  |        #endregion
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// <b>true</b> if this <see cref="RegistryMonitor"/> object is currently monitoring;
  |        /// otherwise, <b>false</b>.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public bool IsMonitoring
  |        {
  |            get { return _thread != null; }
  |        }
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Start monitoring.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public void Start()
  |        {
  |            if (_disposed)
  |                throw new ObjectDisposedException(null, "This instance is already disposed");
  |            
  |            lock (_threadLock)
  |            {
  |                if (!IsMonitoring)
  |                {
  |                    _eventTerminate.Reset();
  |                    _thread = new Thread(new ThreadStart(MonitorThread));
  |                    _thread.IsBackground = true;
  |                    _thread.Start();
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Stops the monitoring thread.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public void Stop()
  |        {
  |            if (_disposed)
  |                throw new ObjectDisposedException(null, "This instance is already disposed");
  |            
  |            lock (_threadLock)
  |            {
  |                Thread thread = _thread;
  |                if (thread != null)
  |                {
  |                    _eventTerminate.Set();
  |                    thread.Join();
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        private void MonitorThread()
  |        {
  |            try
  |            {
  |                ThreadLoop();
  |            }
  |            catch (Exception e)
  |            {
  |                OnError(e);
  |            }
  |            _thread = null;
  |        }
  |
  |        private void ThreadLoop()
  |        {
  |            IntPtr registryKey;
  |            int result = RegOpenKeyEx(_registryHive, _registrySubName, 0, STANDARD_RIGHTS_READ | KEY_QUERY_VALUE | KEY_NOTIFY,
  |                                        out registryKey);
  |            if (result != 0)
  |                throw new Win32Exception(result);
  |
  |            try
  |            {
  |                AutoResetEvent _eventNotify = new AutoResetEvent(false);
  |                WaitHandle[] waitHandles = new WaitHandle[] {_eventNotify, _eventTerminate};
  |                while (!_eventTerminate.WaitOne(0, true))
  |                {
  |                    result = RegNotifyChangeKeyValue(registryKey, true, _regFilter, _eventNotify.SafeWaitHandle.DangerousGetHandle(), true);
  |                    if (result != 0)
  |                        throw new Win32Exception(result);
  |
  |                    if (WaitHandle.WaitAny(waitHandles) == 0)
  |                    {
  |                        OnRegChanged();
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            finally
  |            {
  |                if (registryKey != IntPtr.Zero)
  |                {
  |                    RegCloseKey(registryKey);
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |    }
  |    
  |    /// <summary>
  |    /// Filter for notifications reported by <see cref="RegistryMonitor"/>.
  |    /// </summary>
  |    [Flags]
  |    public enum RegChangeNotifyFilter
  |    {
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller if a subkey is added or deleted.</summary>
  |        Key = 1,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to the attributes of the key,
  |        /// such as the security descriptor information.</summary>
  |        Attribute = 2,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to a value of the key. This can
  |        /// include adding or deleting a value, or changing an existing value.</summary>
  |        Value = 4,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to the security descriptor
  |        /// of the key.</summary>
  |        Security = 8,
  |    }

blank.file.readme.txt	2243 chars, CRLF 54, ends with newline 1
  |k17blank Deployable Archive with Excel Integration
  |
  |Before you can use the functions packaged by the compiler, you need to do the following:
  |
  |* Deploy k17blank.ctf to a server instance.
  |* Install the Excel add-in on the client machine.
  |* Configure the add-in with information about the server instance.
  |
  |1. Deploy k17blank.ctf
  |
  |1.1 Prerequisites to k17blank.ctf Deployment
  |Before you can deploy k17blank.ctf, you need a server instance to host it. The server 
  |instance must be configured to have access to MATLAB Runtime(R2025b).
  |
  |1.2 k17blank.ctf Deployment
  |To deploy k17blank.ctf, copy it from `for_redistribution_files_only\server` or 
  |`k17blankproductionServerArchive` to the server instance's `auto_deploy` folder. The 
  |server instance will automatically deploy it.
  |
  |For more information on deploying k17blank.ctf to MATLAB Production Server, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/mts/server-management.html
  |
  |2. Install Excel Add-In
  |
  |2.1 Using the Installer
  |The Production Server Compiler app generates an installer in the 
  |`for_redistribution\client` folder that will install the Excel Add-In and register all of 
  |the required DLLs.
  |
  |To configure the add-in, enter the information to contact the server instance hosting 
  |k17blank.ctf in the add-in installer when prompted.
  |
  |2.2 Manual Installation
  |In the output folder, you will find the following files:
  |
  |* `k17blank.dll` - dynamic library required by the add-in 
  |* `k17blank.bas` - VBA module file created for the add-in
  |* `k17blank.xla` - Excel add-in file
  |* `serverconfig.dll` - dynamic library managing the server configuration used by the add-in
  |
  |On the client machine running the add-in, you must register the following DLLs with the 
  |`regAsm` command:
  |
  |* `regAsm k17blank.dll`
  |* `regAsm serverconfig.dll`
  |
  |If `k17blank.xla` is generated, install the add-in into Excel. If not, import 
  |`k17blank.bas` to the workbook's Visual Basic project. 
  |
  |Once the add-in is installed, set the server configuration information using the 
  |ServerConfig Excel add-in.
  |
  |For more information on registering and installing the add-in, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/compiler/excel/distribute-add-ins-and-integrate-into-microsoft-excel.html

  |        private static string getServerConfig(string name)
  |        {
  |            string url = null;
  |            RegistryKey key = getAddinRegistryKey(name);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry key " + key.Name + " found");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for mps server url for " + name);
  |                foreach (string valueName in key.GetValueNames())
  |                {
  |                    if(valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) || valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT))
  |                        continue;
  |
  |                    Object value = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + value) ;
  |
  |                    if (value is int)
  |                    {
  |                        if ((int)value == 1)
  |                        {
  |                            url = valueName;
  |                            if (url.EndsWith(".ctf"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Remove(url.IndexOf(".ctf"));
  |                            }
  |                            if (!url.StartsWith("http://") && !url.StartsWith("https://"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Insert(0, "http://");
  |                            }
  |                            return url;
  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Registry key " + name + " doesn't exist");
  |            }
  |
  |            return url;
  |        }

  |        private static void DoLogging()
  |        {
  |            bool loggingEnabled = false;
  |            int loggingLevel = 0;
  |            string logFileFolder = "";

  |            {
  |                loggingEnabled = ((int)value != 0);
  |            }
  |
  |            K17One.loggingEnabled = loggingEnabled;
  |            if (!loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                return;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOGGING_LEVEL);
  |            if (value != null && value is int)
  |            {
  |                loggingLevel = (int)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOG_FILE_FOLDER);
  |            if (value != null && value is string)
  |            {
  |                logFileFolder = (string)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            if (K17One.loggingLevel == loggingLevel && K17One.logFileFolder == logFileFolder)
  |                return;
  |
  |

  |            {
  |                K17One.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                K17One.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                InitializeTraceSourceListener();
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                {
  |                    FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                    if (logFileFolder != K17One.logFileFolder)
  |                    {
  |                        K17One.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                        fListener.CustomLocation = logFileFolder;
  |                    }
  |                    if (loggingLevel != K17One.loggingLevel)
  |                    {
  |                        K17One.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                        SetFileLogListenerFilter(fListener, loggingLevel);
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }

  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for " + valueName + " for " + keyName);

  |                {
  |                    if (name.Equals(valueName))
  |                    {
  |                        Object valueObj = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + valueObj.ToString());

  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }

  |            else

  |        #region Initialization
  |
  |        private void InitRegistryKey(RegistryHive hive, string name)
  |        {
  |            switch (hive)
  |            {
  |                case RegistryHive.ClassesRoot:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.CurrentConfig:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.CurrentUser:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.DynData:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_DYN_DATA;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.LocalMachine:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.PerformanceData:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_PERFORMANCE_DATA;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case RegistryHive.Users:
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_USERS;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                default:
  |                    throw new InvalidEnumArgumentException("hive", (int)hive, typeof (RegistryHive));
  |            }
  |            _registrySubName = name;
  |        }
  |
  |        private void InitRegistryKey(string name)
  |        {
  |            string[] nameParts = name.Split('\\');
  |
  |            switch (nameParts[0])
  |            {
  |                case "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT":
  |                case "HKCR":
  |                   _registryHive = HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_CURRENT_USER":
  |                case "HKCU":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_USER;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE":
  |                    case "HKLM":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_USERS":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_USERS;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                case "HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG":
  |                    _registryHive = HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG;
  |                    break;
  |
  |                default:
  |                    _registryHive = IntPtr.Zero;
  |                    throw new ArgumentException("The registry hive '" + nameParts[0] + "' is not supported", "value");
  |            }
  |
  |            _registrySubName = String.Join("\\", nameParts, 1, nameParts.Length - 1);
  |        }
  |        
  |        #endregion
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// <b>true</b> if this <see cref="RegistryMonitor"/> object is currently monitoring;
  |        /// otherwise, <b>false</b>.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public bool IsMonitoring
  |        {
  |            get { return _thread != null; }
  |        }
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Start monitoring.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public void Start()
  |        {
  |            if (_disposed)
  |                throw new ObjectDisposedException(null, "This instance is already disposed");
  |            
  |            lock (_threadLock)
  |            {
  |                if (!IsMonitoring)
  |                {
  |                    _eventTerminate.Reset();
  |                    _thread = new Thread(new ThreadStart(MonitorThread));
  |                    _thread.IsBackground = true;
  |                    _thread.Start();
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Stops the monitoring thread.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public void Stop()
  |        {
  |            if (_disposed)
  |                throw new ObjectDisposedException(null, "This instance is already disposed");
  |            
  |            lock (_threadLock)
  |            {
  |                Thread thread = _thread;
  |                if (thread != null)
  |                {
  |                    _eventTerminate.Set();
  |                    thread.Join();
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        private void MonitorThread()
  |        {
  |            try
  |            {
  |                ThreadLoop();
  |            }
  |            catch (Exception e)
  |            {
  |                OnError(e);
  |            }
  |            _thread = null;
  |        }
  |
  |        private void ThreadLoop()
  |        {
  |            IntPtr registryKey;
  |            int result = RegOpenKeyEx(_registryHive, _registrySubName, 0, STANDARD_RIGHTS_READ | KEY_QUERY_VALUE | KEY_NOTIFY,
  |                                        out registryKey);
  |            if (result != 0)
  |                throw new Win32Exception(result);
  |
  |            try
  |            {
  |                AutoResetEvent _eventNotify = new AutoResetEvent(false);
  |                WaitHandle[] waitHandles = new WaitHandle[] {_eventNotify, _eventTerminate};
  |                while (!_eventTerminate.WaitOne(0, true))
  |                {
  |                    result = RegNotifyChangeKeyValue(registryKey, true, _regFilter, _eventNotify.SafeWaitHandle.DangerousGetHandle(), true);
  |                    if (result != 0)
  |                        throw new Win32Exception(result);
  |
  |                    if (WaitHandle.WaitAny(waitHandles) == 0)
  |                    {
  |                        OnRegChanged();
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            finally
  |            {
  |                if (registryKey != IntPtr.Zero)
  |                {
  |                    RegCloseKey(registryKey);
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |    }

  |    /// <summary>
  |    /// Filter for notifications reported by <see cref="RegistryMonitor"/>.
  |    /// </summary>
  |    [Flags]
  |    public enum RegChangeNotifyFilter
  |    {
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller if a subkey is added or deleted.</summary>
  |        Key = 1,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to the attributes of the key,
  |        /// such as the security descriptor information.</summary>
  |        Attribute = 2,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to a value of the key. This can
  |        /// include adding or deleting a value, or changing an existing value.</summary>
  |        Value = 4,
  |        /// <summary>Notify the caller of changes to the security descriptor
  |        /// of the key.</summary>
  |        Security = 8,
  |    }

  |k17one Deployable Archive with Excel Integration
  |
  |Before you can use the functions packaged by the compiler, you need to do the following:
  |
  |* Deploy k17one.ctf to a server instance.
  |* Install the Excel add-in on the client machine.
  |* Configure the add-in with information about the server instance.
  |
  |1. Deploy k17one.ctf
  |
  |1.1 Prerequisites to k17one.ctf Deployment
  |Before you can deploy k17one.ctf, you need a server instance to host it. The server 
  |instance must be configured to have access to MATLAB Runtime(R2025b).
  |
  |1.2 k17one.ctf Deployment
  |To deploy k17one.ctf, copy it from `for_redistribution_files_only\server` or 
  |`k17oneproductionServerArchive` to the server instance's `auto_deploy` folder. The server 
  |instance will automatically deploy it.
  |
  |For more information on deploying k17one.ctf to MATLAB Production Server, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/mts/server-management.html
  |
  |2. Install Excel Add-In
  |
  |2.1 Using the Installer
  |The Production Server Compiler app generates an installer in the 
  |`for_redistribution\client` folder that will install the Excel Add-In and register all of 
  |the required DLLs.
  |
  |To configure the add-in, enter the information to contact the server instance hosting 
  |k17one.ctf in the add-in installer when prompted.
  |
  |2.2 Manual Installation
  |In the output folder, you will find the following files:
  |
  |* `k17one.dll` - dynamic library required by the add-in 
  |* `k17one.bas` - VBA module file created for the add-in
  |* `k17one.xla` - Excel add-in file
  |* `serverconfig.dll` - dynamic library managing the server configuration used by the add-in
  |
  |On the client machine running the add-in, you must register the following DLLs with the 
  |`regAsm` command:
  |
  |* `regAsm k17one.dll`
  |* `regAsm serverconfig.dll`
  |
  |If `k17one.xla` is generated, install the add-in into Excel. If not, import `k17one.bas` 
  |to the workbook's Visual Basic project. 
  |
  |Once the add-in is installed, set the server configuration information using the 
  |ServerConfig Excel add-in.
  |
  |For more information on registering and installing the add-in, see: 
  |https://www.mathworks.com/help/compiler/excel/distribute-add-ins-and-integrate-into-microsoft-excel.html

  |using MathWorks.MATLAB.ProductionServer.Client;
  |namespace k17cp
  |{
  | 
  |    public interface IK17Cp
  |    {
  |        [MWCoerceObjectToPrimitiveArrayIfHomogeneous]
  |        [MWPreserveOutputVectorDimensions]
  |        [MWReplaceInputNullWithZero]
  |        void k17_pfun(out Object o0, params Object[] inputs);
  |        [MWCoerceObjectToPrimitiveArrayIfHomogeneous]
  |        [MWPreserveOutputVectorDimensions]
  |        [MWReplaceInputNullWithZero]
  |        void k17_one(out Object y, params Object[] inputs);
  |    } 
  |
  |  /// <summary>
  |  /// The K17Cp class provides a CLS compliant, Object (native) interface to the MATLAB
  |  /// functions contained in the files:
  |  /// <newpara></newpara>
  |  /// <W>\p\src\k17_pfun.p
  |  /// <newpara></newpara>
  |  /// <W>\p\src\k17_one.m
  |  /// </summary>
  |  /// <remarks>
  |  /// @Version 1.0
  |  /// </remarks>
  |    [Guid("<UUID>")]
  |    [ClassInterface(ClassInterfaceType.AutoDual)]
  |    [ComVisible(true)]
  |    public class K17Cp
  |    {
  |        private const string REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY = "Software\\MathWorks\\MATLAB Builder EX\\2.5\\Logging\\";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY = "Software\\MathWorks\\MATLAB Builder EX\\2.5\\MPS Server Config\\";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_LOGGING_ENABLED = "Enabled";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_LOGGING_LEVEL = "LoggingLevel";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_LOG_FILE_FOLDER = "LogFileFolder";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = "timeoutSeconds";
  |        private const string REGISTRY_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT = "responseSizeLimit";
  |        private const int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 120; //2 seconds
  |        private const int DEFAULT_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT = 64; //64MB
  |
  |        //logging
  |        static private TraceSource traceSource = new TraceSource("k17cp Add-in");
  |        static private bool loggingEnabled = false;
  |        static private int loggingLevel = 0;
  |        static private string logFileFolder;
  |        static private RegistryMonitor registryMonitor = null;
  |
  |        //mps server config
  |        private string serverUrl;
  |        private int timeoutMilliSeconds;
  |        private int responseSizeLimit;
  |        private MWClient mwClient = null;
  |        private IK17Cp interfaceObject = null;
  |
  |        //constructor
  |        static K17Cp()
  |        {
  |            AppDomain.CurrentDomain.AssemblyResolve += new ResolveEventHandler(Resolver);
  |            traceSource.Switch.Level = SourceLevels.All;
  |            traceSource.Listeners.Clear();
  |
  |            RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.CreateSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                DoLogging();
  |                registryMonitor = new RegistryMonitor(key);
  |                registryMonitor.RegChanged += new EventHandler(OnRegChanged);
  |                registryMonitor.Start();
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        //destructor
  |        ~K17Cp()
  |        {
  |            if (mwClient != null)
  |            {
  |                mwClient.Dispose();
  |            }
  |            if (registryMonitor != null)
  |            {
  |                registryMonitor.Stop();
  |            }       
  |            if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |            {
  |                FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                if (fListener != null)
  |                {
  |                    fListener.Close();
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        static Assembly Resolver(object sender, ResolveEventArgs args)
  |        {
  |            // The entire code is included in a try-catch to make sure that if anything goes wrong here,
  |            // we return null.
  |            try
  |            {
  |                // We need to make sure that we only promise to load MathWorks.MATLAB.ProductionServer.Client.dll.
  |                // args.Name has the display name of assembly. Display name includes simple name, version number, culture, etc.
  |                // We don't want to manually parse it to just get the simple name. We will be using AssemblyName.Name which 
  |                // is the .NET recommended way.
  |                AssemblyName missingAssemblyDisplayName = new AssemblyName(args.Name);
  |
  |                if ( missingAssemblyDisplayName.Name.Equals("MathWorks.MATLAB.ProductionServer.Client"))
  |                {
  |                    Assembly executingAssembly = Assembly.GetExecutingAssembly();
  |                    Stream s = executingAssembly.GetManifestResourceStream(new AssemblyName(executingAssembly.FullName).Name + "." + missingAssemblyDisplayName.Name + ".dll");
  |                    byte[] block = new byte[s.Length];
  |                    s.Read(block, 0, block.Length);
  |                    Assembly mpsClientAssembly = Assembly.Load(block);                    
  |                    return mpsClientAssembly;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    return null;
  |                }
  |            }   
  |            catch (Exception)
  |            {
  |                return null;
  |            }            
  |        }
  |
  |        #region Methods
  |
  |                /// <summary>
  |        /// Provides an interface for the k17_pfun function in which the input and output
  |        /// arguments are specified as Objects.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        /// <param name="nargout">The number of output arguments to return</param>
  |        /// <param name="o0">Output argument #1</param>
  |        /// <param name="i0">Input argument #1</param>
  |        ///
  |        public void k17_pfun(int nargout, out Object o0, params Object[] inputs)
  |        {
  |            object output0 = null;
  |            Range range = null;
  |            try
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Entered k17_pfun() function.");      
  |                ArrayList input_list = new ArrayList();
  |
  |                int idx = 1;
  |                foreach (Object input in inputs)
  |                {                    
  |                    if (input == Type.Missing)
  |                        break;
  |
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Input {0} is {1}.", idx, input);
  |
  |                    if (input is Range)
  |                    {
  |                        range = input as Range;
  |                        input_list.Add(range.Value);
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Input {0} is Range with value of {1}.", idx, range.Value);
  |                    }
  |                    else
  |                    {
  |                        input_list.Add(input);
  |                    }
  |                    idx++;
  |                }
  |
  |                string url = getServerConfig("k17cp");
  |                int timeout = getTimeoutMilliSeconds("k17cp");
  |                int responseLimit = getResponseSizeLimit("k17cp");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "MPS server URL is {0}.", url);
  |
  |                if (String.IsNullOrEmpty(url))
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MPS server url is not provided for k17cp");
  |                    output0 = "MATLAB error thrown : MPS server url is not provided for k17cp";
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    // Initialize the connection with server
  |                    if ((serverUrl != url) || (timeout != timeoutMilliSeconds) || (responseLimit != responseSizeLimit) || (interfaceObject == null))
  |                    {
  |                        if (mwClient != null)
  |                        {
  |                            mwClient.Dispose();
  |                            TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient is disposed.");
  |                        }
  |                        serverUrl = url;
  |                        timeoutMilliSeconds = timeout;
  |                        responseSizeLimit = responseLimit;
  |                        mwClient = new MWHttpClient(new k17cpClientConfig());
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "New MWHttpClient is created.");
  |                        interfaceObject = mwClient.CreateProxy<IK17Cp>(new Uri(url));
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "MWHttpClient.CreateProxy() succeeded.");
  |                    }
  |
  |                    interfaceObject.k17_pfun(out output0,input_list.ToArray());
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function returned.");
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Information, (int)TraceEventType.Information, "Output o0 is {0}.", output0.ToString());
  |                }
  |            }//end of try
  |            catch (MATLABException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch MATLAB Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "MATLAB Exception stack trace is {0}", ex.MATLABStackTraceString);
  |                String errorMsg = "MATLABException:" + ex.MATLABIdentifier;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (WebException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch WebException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "WebException status is {0}", ex.Status);
  |        
  |                HttpWebResponse response = (HttpWebResponse)ex.Response;
  |                if (response != null)
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status code: {0}", response.StatusCode);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "HttpWebResponse status description: {0}", response.StatusDescription);
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + response.StatusDescription;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "No response received in WebException.");
  |                    String errorMsg = "WebException:" + ex.Status;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (TargetInvocationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch TargetInvocationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "InnerException is {0}", ex.InnerException);
  |                String errorMsg = "TargetInvocationException:" + ex.InnerException;
  |
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |            }
  |            catch (InvalidOperationException ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function failed.");
  |                //When the log file reached its max size
  |                if (ex.Message.Contains("MaxFileSize"))
  |                {
  |                    string filename = "";
  |                    if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                    {
  |                        FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                        filename = fListener.FullLogFileName;
  |                    }
  |                    String errorMsg = ex.Message + " Delete or rename the log file " + filename + " and run the function again.";
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |                else
  |                {
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch InvalidOperationException: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                    String errorMsg = "InvalidOperationException:" + ex.Message;
  |                    output0 = errorMsg;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            catch (Exception ex)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Call to k17_pfun function failed.");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Catch Exception: {0}", ex.Message);
  |                String errorMsg = "Exception:" + ex.Message;
  |                output0 = errorMsg;
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            o0 = output0;
  |
  |            if (loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                traceSource.Flush();
  |
  |            }
  |
  |            return;
  |        }

  |        private static string getLogFileLocation()
  |        {
  |            string url = null;
  |            RegistryKey key = getLoggingRegistryKey();
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                object value = key.GetValue("LogFileFolder");
  |                if (value is string)
  |                {
  |                    url = (string)value;
  |                }
  |            }
  |            return url;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static RegistryKey getLoggingRegistryKey()
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                RegistryKey localMachineRegistry= RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine,
  |                                          Environment.Is64BitOperatingSystem ? RegistryView.Registry64 : RegistryView.Registry32);
  |                key = localMachineRegistry.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            }
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_LOGGING_KEY);
  |            }
  |            return key;
  |        }
  |                
  |        private static RegistryKey getAddinRegistryKey(string addinName)
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = Registry.CurrentUser.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                RegistryKey localMachineRegistry= RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey(RegistryHive.LocalMachine,
  |                                          Environment.Is64BitOperatingSystem ? RegistryView.Registry64 : RegistryView.Registry32);
  |                key = localMachineRegistry.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            }
  |            if (key == null)
  |            {
  |                key = Registry.LocalMachine.OpenSubKey(REGISTRY_MPS_SERVER_CONFIG_KEY + addinName);
  |            }
  |            return key;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static string getServerConfig(string name)
  |        {
  |            string url = null;
  |            RegistryKey key = getAddinRegistryKey(name);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry key " + key.Name + " found");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for mps server url for " + name);
  |                foreach (string valueName in key.GetValueNames())
  |                {
  |                    if(valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_TIMEOUT_SECONDS) || valueName.Equals(REGISTRY_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT))
  |                        continue;
  |
  |                    Object value = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                    TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + value) ;
  |
  |                    if (value is int)
  |                    {
  |                        if ((int)value == 1)
  |                        {
  |                            url = valueName;
  |                            if (url.EndsWith(".ctf"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Remove(url.IndexOf(".ctf"));
  |                            }
  |                            if (!url.StartsWith("http://") && !url.StartsWith("https://"))
  |                            {
  |                                url = url.Insert(0, "http://");
  |                            }
  |                            return url;
  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Registry key " + name + " doesn't exist");
  |            }
  |
  |            return url;
  |        }
  |
  |        private static void DoLogging()
  |        {
  |            bool loggingEnabled = false;
  |            int loggingLevel = 0;
  |            string logFileFolder = "";
  |
  |            RegistryKey key = getLoggingRegistryKey();
  |            if (key == null)
  |                return;
  |
  |            Object value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOGGING_ENABLED);
  |            if (value != null && value is int)
  |            {
  |                loggingEnabled = ((int)value != 0);
  |            }
  |
  |            K17Cp.loggingEnabled = loggingEnabled;
  |            if (!loggingEnabled)
  |            {
  |                return;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOGGING_LEVEL);
  |            if (value != null && value is int)
  |            {
  |                loggingLevel = (int)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            value = key.GetValue(REGISTRY_LOG_FILE_FOLDER);
  |            if (value != null && value is string)
  |            {
  |                logFileFolder = (string)value;
  |            }
  |
  |            if (K17Cp.loggingLevel == loggingLevel && K17Cp.logFileFolder == logFileFolder)
  |                return;
  |
  |
  |            if (traceSource.Listeners.Count == 0)
  |            {
  |                K17Cp.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                K17Cp.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                InitializeTraceSourceListener();
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                if (traceSource.Listeners[0] is FileLogTraceListener)
  |                {
  |                    FileLogTraceListener fListener = (FileLogTraceListener)traceSource.Listeners[0];
  |                    if (logFileFolder != K17Cp.logFileFolder)
  |                    {
  |                        K17Cp.logFileFolder = logFileFolder;
  |                        fListener.CustomLocation = logFileFolder;
  |                    }
  |                    if (loggingLevel != K17Cp.loggingLevel)
  |                    {
  |                        K17Cp.loggingLevel = loggingLevel;
  |                        SetFileLogListenerFilter(fListener, loggingLevel);
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
  |
  |        private static void InitializeTraceSourceListener()
  |        {
  |            traceSource.Listeners.Clear();
  |
  |            // Initilize FileLogTraceListener      
  |            FileLogTraceListener fListener = new FileLogTraceListener();
  |            fListener.AutoFlush = true;
  |            fListener.Delimiter = "  ";

  |        private static bool getRegistryIntValue(string keyName, string valueName, ref int value)
  |        {
  |            RegistryKey key = getAddinRegistryKey(keyName);
  |            if (key != null)
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry key " + key.Name + " found");
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Looking for " + valueName + " for " + keyName);
  |                foreach (string name in key.GetValueNames())
  |                {
  |                    if (name.Equals(valueName))
  |                    {
  |                        Object valueObj = key.GetValue(valueName);
  |                        TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Verbose, (int)TraceEventType.Verbose, "Registry value name: " + valueName + " , value data: " + valueObj.ToString());
  |
  |                        if(valueObj is int)
  |                        {
  |                            value = (int) valueObj;
  |                            return true;
  |                        }
  |                    }
  |                }
  |            }
  |            else
  |            {
  |                TraceEvent(TraceEventType.Critical, (int)TraceEventType.Critical, "Registry key " + keyName + " doesn't exist");
  |            }
  |            return false;
  |        }

  |            {

  |            }
  |            else 
  |            {
  |                return DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS * 1000;
  |            }
  |        }

  |            {
  |                return limit * 1024 * 1024;
  |            }
  |            else 
  |            {
  |                return DEFAULT_RESPONSE_SIZE_LIMIT * 1024 * 1024;
  |            }
  |        }

  |    public class RegistryMonitor : IDisposable

  |        #region P/Invoke

  |        [DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
  |        private static extern int RegOpenKeyEx(IntPtr hKey, string subKey, uint options, int samDesired,

  |                                                          RegChangeNotifyFilter dwNotifyFilter, IntPtr hEvent,
  |                                                          bool fAsynchronous);

  |        [DllImport("advapi32.dll", SetLastError = true)]
  |        private static extern int RegCloseKey(IntPtr hKey);
  |
  |        private const int KEY_QUERY_VALUE = 0x0001;
  |        private const int KEY_NOTIFY = 0x0010;
  |        private const int STANDARD_RIGHTS_READ = 0x00020000;
  |
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000000));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_CURRENT_USER = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000001));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000002));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_USERS = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000003));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_PERFORMANCE_DATA = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000004));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_CURRENT_CONFIG = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000005));
  |        private static readonly IntPtr HKEY_DYN_DATA = new IntPtr(unchecked((int) 0x80000006));
  |
  |        #endregion
  |
  |        #region Event handling
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Occurs when the specified registry key has changed.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        public event EventHandler RegChanged;
  |        
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Raises the <see cref="RegChanged"/> event.
  |        /// </summary>
  |        /// <remarks>
  |        /// <p>
  |        /// <b>OnRegChanged</b> is called when the specified registry key has changed.
  |        /// </p>
  |        /// <note type="inheritinfo">
  |        /// When overriding <see cref="OnRegChanged"/> in a derived class, be sure to call
  |        /// the base class's <see cref="OnRegChanged"/> method.
  |        /// </note>
  |        /// </remarks>
  |        protected virtual void OnRegChanged()
  |        {
  |            EventHandler handler = RegChanged;
  |            if (handler != null)
  |                handler(this, null);
  |        }
  |
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Occurs when the access to the registry fails.
  |        /// </summary>

  |        
  |        /// <summary>
  |        /// Raises the <see cref="Error"/> event.
  |        /// </summary>

  |        /// <remarks>
  |        /// <p>
  |        /// <b>OnError</b> is called when an exception occurs while watching the registry.
  |        /// </p>
  |        /// <note type="inheritinfo">
  |        /// When overriding <see cref="OnError"/> in a derived class, be sure to call
  |        /// the base class's <see cref="OnError"/> method.
  |        /// </note>
  |        /// </remarks>
  |        protected virtual void OnError(Exception e)
  |        {
  |            ErrorEventHandler handler = Error;
  |            if (handler != null)
  |                handler(this, new ErrorEventArgs(e));
  |        }

  |        /// Gets or sets the <see cref="RegChangeNotifyFilter">RegChangeNotifyFilter</see>.
  |        /// </summary>

  |            get { return _regFilter; }
  |            set

  |                lock (_threadLock)
  |                {
  |                    if (IsMonitoring)
  |                        throw new InvalidOperationException("Monitoring thread is already running");
  |
  |                    _regFilter = value;
  |                }
  |            }
  |        }
